title: Albumin–NLR interaction fails to establish improved cross-cycle prediction of C-reactive protein
abstract: In exploratory transfer from NHANES 2007–2008 (4,816 adults) to 2009–2010 (5,181), one albumin × log-NLR interaction changed weighted log-CRP prediction MSE by +0.000940 (joint source/target stratified PSU-bootstrap 95% interval -0.002153 to +0.007283). Incremental predictive benefit was not established.
